# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

## cand_0001
- The failure summary in INSTRUCTIONS leads with `action_checks` ("update_reservation_flights:
  agent used ..."), but for this benchmark reward = DB × COMMUNICATE and action_match is
  informational — several PASSING tasks have action_match=False. Surfacing `reward_breakdown`
  (DB vs COMMUNICATE) and the failing `communicate_checks[*].info` in the summary would point the
  optimizer at the real defect faster; the action-level line actively misdirects (it flags a task
  whose DB is already correct as an "action defect").
- INSTRUCTIONS say "EMPTY SEED — the capability directory is EMPTY" but `tools/tools.py` was in fact
  the full tau2 default surface (14 tools). That contradiction cost time; the empty-seed language
  should be gated on `is_empty(dir)` actually being true.
- No venv was on PATH / importable as `tau2`; I had to discover `venv-skillberry-tau2` by probing.
  Documenting the exact interpreter to use for the VERIFY-THE-FIX snippet would save every iteration
  that guesswork.
